external_games.name: Love, I'm Not Good For You

name: Love, I'm Not Good For You
storyline: EP1: A woman receives a message from her boyfriend. He wants to break up! Join our protagonist in her journey handling her relationship with her boyfriend (or ex bf!), old and new friends, family and dealing with her own identity.
summary:
A woman receives a message from her boyfriend. He wants to break up! Join our protagonist in her journey handling her relationship with her boyfriend (or ex bf!), old and new friends, family and dealing with her own identity.

"Love, I'm not good for you" is a romance / mystery visual novel, with point-and-click elements, about relationships coming to an end... or maybe not? You can explore the phones of our protagonists to understand their lives before and after they break up (or not!).

There's only one ending but HOW you reach that ending changes depending on your choices!
